ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~8:2) between dominant low-intensity (black/charcoal) background pixels and sparse high-intensity (white/light-grey) punctate regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Irregular scattering of white circular blobs and annular rings. High density on left lobe mid-section; dense clustering on right lobe central-lateral area. Tan/white clusters located at normalized coordinates (x:0.05, y:0.35) and (x:0.95, y:0.3).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, sharp V-shaped indentation with a vertex at approximately (x:0.5, y:0.51). Calculated internal angle is approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Distinct serrated trailing edge. Left lobe: 8 identified peaks with 5-12 pixel amplitude. Right lobe: 6 macro-serrations with 8-15 pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a convex arc from the lateral tips toward the medial notch, characterized by a quadratic sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular high-contrast clusters (white-on-black) measuring 4-10 pixels in diameter, distributed globally across both lobes, consistent with barnacle scar patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, non-parallel white linear marks. Notable horizontal mark on left lobe at (x:0.3, y:0.45) and diagonal marks at (x:0.6, y:0.52).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural/biological encrustations on both distal lobe tips exhibiting irregular high-intensity calcified texture. Vertical striations visible near the center of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density 'donut' scar morphology consisting of dark interior pixels surrounded by a thin high-intensity white perimeter ring.
